cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've settled things with the headteacher, love. We discussed your suspension. You may have tea beside me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you tell me how long I'm out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, sweetheart. You're allowed to know it's a little while, and I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may rehearse every line with me, sweetheart. I've decided you shall have an audience here, whatever happens.
